_about: Inputs of the RainReady screening simulator v2 (screening.py / screening.ts). Researched 21 Oct 2026 by Claude for the team leader from MSMA 2nd Edition and public data; see research/HY_screening_inputs.md. Every value has a unit, status, source and confidence.

_status_key.measured: measured from the model (areas, land cover)
_status_key.planner input: a what-if set by the user

ari_years.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 1 Design Acceptance Criteria, Table 1.1: link house / apartment, major system 100 yr; mixed developments take the highest ARI (Note 1)

lambda.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.B1 (ARI 2-100 yr, 5 min-72 h), station 2913001

kappa.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.B1, station 2913001

theta.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.B1, station 2913001

eta.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.B1, station 2913001

station_choice.source: Nearest Selangor gauge in Table 2.B1 to BBR (3.09 N, 101.44 E). Location checked 21 Oct 2026 on JPS Selangor's own station layer (jpsselgis.selangor.gov.my, Hosted/Stesen_Hidrologi, 'Stesen Rain Fall'): Telemetri Telok Gong at 2.9951 N, 101.3679 E, about 13 km south-west of BBR, in Klang district, coastal like BBR; it matches the station-number grid (29 = 2.9 N, 13 = 101.3 E). Nearer JPS gauges (Bandar Klang, Pekan Meru) have no IDF constants in Table 2.B1. Neighbours 3314001 and 2815001 give a sensitivity range
station_choice.note: Location H (JPS layer); that the telemetry station is the IDF gauge 2913001 is inferred from the name and grid (M)

durations_h.source: MSMA 2.2.1: examine a range of storm durations; storm duration >= tc (MSMA 2.2.2). The critical one (most storage) is reported

design_duration_h.source: Empty: the design storm is today's critical duration. Set to one of durations_h to hold the storm fixed, e.g. so a blocked drain is compared with the clean drain under the same storm

tc_hours.source: MSMA Table 2.1: overland flow (paved n* 0.015, 200 m, 1 % slope) ~9 min + drain flow (1 km, n 0.018, R 0.5 m, S 0.0013) ~13 min = ~23 min, rounded up to 0.5 h. Used for the pre-development peak (allowed release)

hydrograph_volume_factor.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, 2.3.2 Rational Hydrograph Method: Type 1 trapezoid and Type 2 triangle both hold Q x d

c_predevelopment.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.5 'Sport Fields, Park and Agriculture' (major system). BBR was a Sime Darby oil palm estate before the 2002 master plan (Wikipedia 'Bukit Raja'; EdgeProp)
c_predevelopment.note: Used for MSMA 1.2.1 peak discharge control: Qpost <= Qpre

band_change_medium_from.source: Team choice: a scenario needing 5 % more storage (or trunk demand) than today is 'medium'

band_change_high_from.source: Team choice: 20 % more than today is 'high'

band_capacity_medium_from.source: Team choice: storage required at 80 % of an entered stated capacity

band_capacity_high_from.source: At or above 100 % the entered capacity is exceeded

area_ha.source: Plan area of the DRAFT zone (data/zones.json), water included
area_ha.note: Zone edges are a draft from mapped lines (TOWNSHIP_3D_AND_SIMULATOR.md 4.8), not an official catchment

c_now.source: MSMA 2 Table 2.5 (Major System column) area-weighted by Eq. 2.4 over the zone's land cover in the model (landcover.py: terrace 0.90, commercial 0.95, park 0.40, bare 0.60, grass 0.50, roads 0.95, water 0.95)
c_now.note: Land cover is the SIMULATED model town; table values are H, the cover is M-L

EXT_A.name: Area A beyond the model edge (upstream, Shah Alam side)
EXT_A.enters_at: the drain that crosses the council line (3.09294 N, 101.44433 E)

area_ha.source: No usable upstream boundary exists (AR1, 11 Oct 2026: terrain routing failed; JPS Kawasan_Tadahan unavailable). 50 ha is a stated test value; the website lets the planner change it

c_now.source: Same as the in-model part of Area A (Z01)

c_upstream.source: Scenario definition: the remaining land develops as link and terrace housing (MSMA 2 Table 2.5, major system, 0.90), where peak control is not fully achieved. A what-if, not a forecast of Area A

trunk_drain._what: The east-west drain at y ~ 300 that carries the north side, Area A and the pond outlets west to the main ditch

top_width_m.source: Not measurable (tree cover at the council corner, AR1 imagery). Between the model's 3 m ditch and the 8-10 m main ditch it joins (AR1 imagery, 3.0976 N 101.4337 E)

bottom_width_m.source: Trapezoid like the main ditch (AR1 imagery)

depth_m.source: Typical for an urban concrete trunk drain; not measured

manning_n.source: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.3: lined drain, concrete, rough finish

slope.source: Regional ground fall 1.3 m/km (AR1 plane fit to GLO-30 over 18 km2, M); drain gradients inside the block cannot be read from the DEM

blockage.source: Share of the drain's carrying capacity lost to silt and rubbish (0 = clean, as designed). Not measured anywhere public; a maintenance what-if. Screening simplification: capacity scales by (1 - blockage); capped at 0.9

trunk_drain._limit: Only this drain is counted as conveyance; overland and road (major-system) flow paths are not, so storage required is an upper-end screening figure

capacity_m3.source: No public figure (AR1). Must not be measured from the model. Enter the stated capacity to see the gap
No public figure (AR1). Enter the stated capacity

what_if_pond._what: Illustrative new pond on land OSM tags brownfield (way 1267917541, 6.6 ha) in zone Z06, catching Z06 runoff before pond A. A what-if, not a proposal

capacity_m3.source: Test size for the what-if (a planner input, not a fact)

outlet_m3_s.source: Default 0: the what-if pond holds what it catches during the storm and empties afterwards. With the trunk drain full, a pond that passes flow on does not reduce pond A's storage

upstream.label: More paved land upstream, where peak control is not fully achieved

upstream_plus_pond.label: Upstream change, plus a what-if pond
